Constructive waves deposit; destructive waves erode.

items: Frequently tested: A Tombolo connects an island to the mainland, not two mainlands.
Sequence of coastal erosion landforms: Sea arches collapse to form Stacks.
Wave Action Rule: Constructive waves deposit sediments, while destructive waves erode the coastline.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Longshore drift transports sediments along the coast.
A stack is formed following the collapse of an arch.
A tombolo is a landform that connects an island to the mainland.
Barrier reefs are characterized by the presence of lagoons.
Constructive waves build up land by depositing sediments, whereas destructive waves break down land through erosion.
